name: Time Doctor
description_en:
Time Doctor connects tracked employee time, tasks and activity with workforce reports and payroll/billing inputs. Capture controls and permissions determine what an organization collects; it should not be summarized as automatic proof of work quality.

The current homepage distinguishes the available MCP connection from Ask AI and AI Signals marked coming soon. Roadmap labels must not be converted into current capabilities.
description_zh:
Time Doctor 将员工工时、任务及活动连接到劳动力报告和薪资/计费输入。采集控制及权限决定组织收集什么，不能概括为自动证明工作质量。

当前首页区分已介绍的 MCP 连接，以及标为即将推出的 Ask AI、AI Signals，不能把路线图标签转换为现成功能。

core_features.explanation_en: Associate recorded work with tasks/tools and reporting periods.
core_features.explanation_zh: 将记录工作关联到任务/工具及报告期。

core_features.explanation_en: Standard adds schedules, attendance and approvals; advanced reports and add-ons have separate scope.
core_features.explanation_zh: Standard 加排班、考勤及审批，高级报告/附加项范围另定。

en: Define users, tasks, capture policy and pay periods, then review a work interval and a manual correction. Compare the approved report with the payroll destination. App activity and screenshots provide context, not a complete determination of payable labor. After a missing sync, inspect source entries and approval state before repeating an export. No payroll or tracker was executed.
zh: 定义用户、任务、采集政策及工资周期，再审查工作时段与人工更正，对照已批报告和薪资目标。应用活动及截图提供背景，不能完整决定应付劳动。同步遗漏后，重导出前先检查原记录及审批。本次未运行薪资或追踪器。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative evaluation workflow; no customer adoption or savings measured.

sections.title_en: Do not invent missing dynamic prices
sections.en:
The pricing page exposes Basic, Standard, Premium and Enterprise, but base numeric rates render as placeholder labels in the read text. They remain unknown. A fourteen-day trial requires no card; it is not sustained free use. Some add-on figures do render, including $200 per integration monthly for HRIS or payroll native integrations.

Enterprise lists private cloud and custom contract options. These are not blanket self-hosting or open-source rights. Confirm seats, cadence, add-ons, currency and deployment in a quote; do not substitute an old remembered base price.
sections.zh:
定价页展示 Basic、Standard、Premium 及 Enterprise，但读取的基础金额是占位标签，因此保持未知。十四天试用无需卡，不是长期免费。部分附加数字可读，例如 HRIS 或原生薪资集成每集成每月 $200。

Enterprise 列出私有云及定制合同选项，不是通用自托管或开源权。应报价确认席位、周期、附加项、货币及部署，不能用记忆中的旧基础价补齐。

sections.en:
Workforce operations teams can evaluate record review and capacity analysis; a private personal journal is a different scope. Establish employee visibility, role permissions and screenshot/retention policy before collection. Planned AI outputs should be excluded from acceptance requirements until actually available.

No client capture, anomaly detection, role enforcement, MCP, financial calculation, licence or restore was tested. Vendor compliance badges and efficiency statistics remain unverified by this research.
sections.zh:
劳动力运营团队可评估记录审查及容量分析，私人个人日志属于不同范围。采集前先明确员工可见性、角色权限及截图/保留政策。计划中的 AI 输出在实际开放前应排除在验收要求之外。

未测试客户端采集、异常检测、角色执行、MCP、财务计算、许可或恢复。厂商合规徽章和效率统计未经本研究独立核实。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: Base rates are unresolved dynamic placeholders. No AI roadmap availability, device, API, privacy, payroll, licence or restore test.
research_gaps.zh: 基础价为未明确动态占位符，未测试 AI 路线图开放、设备、API、隐私、薪资、许可或恢复。
